name: last-mile-delivery-tracker
description: Last-mile logistics platform: configurable rate engine, explainable auto-assignment, immutable tracking history.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lmd/shared && npm run build --workspace @lmd/api && npm run build --workspace @lmd/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @lmd/api & npm run dev --workspace @lmd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @lmd/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && bash scripts/verify-submission.sh
